questions: In fully visible middle frames, are exactly three pens visible on the white carrier?
Does each pen show a visible black cap-like part at its lower end?
Does any pen show an exposed pointed writing tip where the black cap-like part should be?
Are the three pens parallel and similarly oriented on the carrier?
Are the black cap-like parts on the same end of all three pens?
Is any pen reversed or upside down compared with the other pens?
Is any pen tilted or diagonal compared with the other pens?
Does the carrier move smoothly from LEFT to RIGHT while the pens remain stable relative to it?

question_answers.evidence: From frame 00:04 onwards, exactly three pens are clearly visible on the white carrier plate.
All three pens display a black cap-like part at their lower end in the fully visible frames (e.g., 00:06).
No pen shows an exposed pointed tip; all have the black cap-like part at the bottom.
The three pens are arranged in a parallel vertical row with consistent spacing.
The black cap-like parts are located at the bottom end for all three pens.
All pens are oriented with the cap down and barrel up; none are reversed.
All pens are vertically aligned and parallel to each other.
The carrier enters from the left and moves right, stopping with the pens fully in view.

parsed.reason: All three pens are visible, parallel, and have the black cap-like part at the same end. No anomalies are detected.
